what: Scattered images (product cutouts) and the name pill below are paired by the same key. Hovering either the image or the pill instantly swaps that pair’s image to the second image (another pose), and the pill lifts 3px and fills with 80% accent color (.3s ease-out). With waves, on first open the data-wave groups turn on in three batches at 100·700·1300ms, .5s each (swing)

options.[data-fx-part=item] > [data-fx-part=main: Paired picture and the first·second pictures overlapped inside it — paired by data-key
options.waves: Start times (ms) separated by commas, e.g. ”100, 700, 1300” — [data-wave=The element carrying 0|1|2] turns on at that step. If absent, nothing turns on
options.min: Run the intro only on windows at least this wide (px) — narrow windows show everything right away (original 901)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: look: fade — length·curve of the cross-swap (via style), default .3s · linear
options.--fx-lift · --fx-label-dur · --fx-label-: Pill hover distance, duration and curve (via style), default -3px · .3s · ease-out
options.look: With fade, the second image overlays the first and shows through to swap (by default, like the original, display is switched immediately, so if the two images differ in size the cell height changes too)

use: Product name
note: On devices without hover, the pair reveal is not applied (the original phone version hides the image and keeps only the pill). With reduced motion everything shows without the reveal, and the pair swap stays as is

from.where: index.html .pc-hero (five cutouts ↔ five name pills, waves 100·700·1300)
